```{python}
#| label: setup
import html as html_lib
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython.display import HTML, display
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots

DATA_ROOT = Path("../data") if Path("../data").exists() else Path("data")
MART_DIR = DATA_ROOT / "mart"
RAW_DIR = DATA_ROOT / "raw" if (DATA_ROOT / "raw").exists() else DATA_ROOT

kpi_df = pd.read_parquet(MART_DIR / "mart_kpi_summary.parquet")
pnl_df = pd.read_parquet(MART_DIR / "mart_monthly_pnl.parquet").sort_values("month")
cf_df = pd.read_parquet(MART_DIR / "mart_monthly_cashflow.parquet").sort_values("month")
exc_df = pd.read_parquet(MART_DIR / "mart_exceptions.parquet")

# Convert Python Decimal columns to float for Plotly serialization
for df in (kpi_df, pnl_df, cf_df, exc_df):
    for col in df.columns:
        if df[col].dtype == "object" and not df[col].dropna().empty:
            if hasattr(df[col].dropna().iloc[0], "as_tuple"):
                df[col] = df[col].astype(float)

for df in (pnl_df, cf_df):
    df["month_label"] = pd.to_datetime(df["month"]).dt.strftime("%b %Y")

kpi = kpi_df.iloc[0]

INK, SLATE_LIGHT, NAVY, COBALT, INDIGO, BLUE, RED, AMBER, ORANGE = (
    "#1e293b",
    "#cbd5e1",
    "#1e3a8a",
    "#3b82f6",
    "#6366f1",
    "#2563eb",
    "#dc2626",
    "#d97706",
    "#ea580c",
)

LAYOUT = dict(
    autosize=True,
    height=460,
    font=dict(family="Source Sans 3, Segoe UI, sans-serif", color=INK),
    plot_bgcolor="#ffffff",
    paper_bgcolor="#ffffff",
    margin=dict(l=20, r=30, t=85, b=40),
    hovermode="x unified",
    hoverlabel=dict(
        namelength=-1,
        bgcolor="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96)",
        bordercolor="#cbd5e1",
        font=dict(family="Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif", size=12, color=INK),
    ),
    legend=dict(
        orientation="h",
        yanchor="bottom",
        y=1.02,
        xanchor="center",
        x=0.5,
        entrywidth=0.33,
        entrywidthmode="fraction",
    ),
)

CONFIG = {"displayModeBar": False, "responsive": True}


def fmt_eur(val: float, decimals: int = 0) -> str:
    sign = "-" if val < 0 else ""
    return f"{sign}€{abs(val):,.{decimals}f}"
```

```{python}
#| label: cost-structure-totals
rev_6m = float(pnl_df["net_revenue_eur"].sum())
cogs_6m = -float(pnl_df["cogs_eur"].abs().sum())
fees_6m = -float(pnl_df["financial_fees_eur"].abs().sum())
mkt_6m = -float(pnl_df["marketing_ads_eur"].abs().sum())
opex_6m = -float(pnl_df["opex_fixed_eur"].abs().sum())
uncl_6m = -float(pnl_df["unclassified_outflows_eur"].abs().sum())
net_6m = rev_6m + cogs_6m + fees_6m + mkt_6m + opex_6m + uncl_6m

wf_vals = [rev_6m, cogs_6m, fees_6m, mkt_6m, opex_6m, uncl_6m, net_6m]
wf_text = [f"{'-' if v < 0 else ''}€{abs(v) / 1000:.1f}k" for v in wf_vals]

fig_totals = go.Figure(
    go.Waterfall(
        x=["Net Revenue", "COGS", "Stripe & FX", "Marketing Ads", "Fixed OpEx", "Unclassified", "6M EBITDA"],
        measure=["relative", "relative", "relative", "relative", "relative", "relative", "total"],
        y=[rev_6m, cogs_6m, fees_6m, mkt_6m, opex_6m, uncl_6m, 0],
        text=wf_text,
        textposition="outside",
        textfont=dict(size=11.5),
        connector=dict(line=dict(color="#cbd5e1", width=1.5, dash="dot")),
        increasing=dict(marker=dict(color=NAVY)),
        decreasing=dict(marker=dict(color="#64748b")),
        totals=dict(marker=dict(color=RED if net_6m < 0 else "#0d9488")),
        hovertemplate="%{x}: <b>%{text}</b><br>Cumulative balance: €%{final:,.0f}<extra></extra>",
    )
)

fig_totals.update_layout(
    **(LAYOUT | {"showlegend": False, "margin": dict(l=20, r=20, t=45, b=55)})
)
fig_totals.update_xaxes(
    ticks="outside",
    ticklen=10,
    tickcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
)
fig_totals.update_yaxes(
    title_text="Cumulative (EUR)",
    tickprefix="€",
    gridcolor="#f1f5f9",
    zeroline=True,
    zerolinecolor="#cbd5e1",
    range=[min(0, net_6m) * 1.9, rev_6m * 1.15],
)
fig_totals.show(config=CONFIG)
```

::: {.panel-box}
### Cash runway under revenue stress

```{python}
#| label: cash-runway
RUNWAY_CAP = 18
SHOCKS = list(range(5, 55, 5))
DEFAULT_SHOCK = 30
months = cf_df["month_label"]


def runway(shock_pct: float) -> pd.Series:
    """Months of cash runway remaining under a revenue inflow shock."""
    flow = cf_df["net_cashflow_eur"] - shock_pct / 100 * cf_df["cash_inflows_eur"]
    burn = (-flow).clip(lower=0)
    return (cf_df["ending_cash_eur"] / burn.where(burn > 0)).fillna(RUNWAY_CAP).clip(upper=RUNWAY_CAP)


cash = cf_df["ending_cash_eur"]
base_runway = runway(0)


def make_bar_text(shock_pct: float) -> list[str]:
    shock_runway = runway(shock_pct)
    labels = []
    for i, (v, b, s) in enumerate(zip(cash, base_runway, shock_runway)):
        b_color = RED if b < 3.0 else BLUE
        s_color = RED if s < 3.0 else AMBER
        header = f"<b>€{v / 1000:.1f}k</b> · Current" if i == len(cash) - 1 else f"<b>€{v / 1000:.1f}k</b>"
        labels.append(
            f"{header}<br>"
            f"<span style='color:{b_color}'><b>{b:.1f} mo</b></span>"
            f"<span style='color:#94a3b8'> | </span>"
            f"<span style='color:{s_color}'><b>{s:.1f} mo</b></span>"
        )
    return labels


bar_colors = ["#64748b"] * (len(cash) - 1) + [NAVY]

fig_cf = go.Figure()

fig_cf.add_trace(
    go.Bar(
        x=months,
        y=cash,
        name="Ending cash (EUR)",
        marker_color=bar_colors,
        opacity=0.9,
        text=make_bar_text(DEFAULT_SHOCK),
        textposition="outside",
        textfont=dict(size=11.5),
        hovertemplate="Ending cash: €%{y:,.0f}<extra></extra>",
    )
)

# Legend-only traces representing runway state colors
fig_cf.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=[None],
        y=[None],
        mode="markers",
        marker=dict(color=BLUE, size=9, symbol="square"),
        name="Runway · base case",
    )
)

for shock in SHOCKS:
    fig_cf.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[None],
            y=[None],
            mode="markers",
            marker=dict(color=AMBER, size=9, symbol="square"),
            visible=(shock == DEFAULT_SHOCK),
            name=f"Runway · revenue −{shock}%",
        )
    )

fig_cf.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=[None],
        y=[None],
        mode="markers",
        marker=dict(color=RED, size=9, symbol="square"),
        name="Runway < 3.0 mo (alert)",
    )
)

slider_steps = [
    dict(
        method="update",
        label=f"−{shock}%",
        args=[
            {
                "visible": [True, True] + [s == shock for s in SHOCKS] + [True],
                "text": [make_bar_text(shock)] + [None] * (len(SHOCKS) + 2),
            }
        ],
    )
    for shock in SHOCKS
]

fig_cf.update_layout(
    **(LAYOUT | {"margin": dict(l=20, r=20, t=85, b=100)}),
    sliders=[
        dict(
            active=SHOCKS.index(DEFAULT_SHOCK),
            steps=slider_steps,
            currentvalue=dict(prefix="Revenue shock: ", font=dict(size=13)),
            pad=dict(t=30),
        )
    ],
)
fig_cf.update_yaxes(
    visible=True,
    title_text="Ending cash (EUR)",
    tickprefix="€",
    dtick=10000,
    gridcolor="#f1f5f9",
    range=[0, float(cash.max()) * 1.25],
)
fig_cf.show(config=CONFIG)
```

### Accounting exceptions

```{python}
#| label: exceptions-table
def severity_badge(sev: str) -> str:
    return f'<span class="sev-badge sev-{sev.lower()}">{sev}</span>'


exc = exc_df.loc[exc_df["amount_eur"].abs().sort_values(ascending=False).index]

exc_table = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Severity": exc["severity"].map(severity_badge),
        "Date": pd.to_datetime(exc["event_date"]).dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "Anomaly": exc["anomaly_type"],
        "Reference": exc["reference_id"],
        "Original": [f"{amt:,.2f} {ccy}" for amt, ccy in zip(exc["amount_orig"], exc["currency"])],
        "Impact (EUR)": exc["amount_eur"].map(lambda v: fmt_eur(v, 2)),
        "Recommended action": exc["recommended_action"],
    }
)

table_html = exc_table.to_html(index=False, escape=False, border=0, justify="center", classes="exceptions")
display(HTML(f'<div class="table-wrap">{table_html}</div>'))
```

## 2. Raw Data (Before)

::: {.panel-box}

```{python}
#| label: raw-csv-viewer
MAX_PREVIEW_ROWS = 200
csv_files = sorted(RAW_DIR.rglob("*.csv")) if RAW_DIR.exists() else []

if not csv_files:
    display(HTML("<p style='color:#64748b; margin:0;'>No CSV files found in the data directory.</p>"))
else:
    buttons_html = []
    panels_html = []
    first_meta = ""

    for idx, csv_path in enumerate(csv_files):
        active_cls = " active" if idx == 0 else ""
        display_style = "block" if idx == 0 else "none"

        raw_df = pd.read_csv(csv_path, dtype=str, keep_default_na=False)
        total_rows, total_cols = raw_df.shape
        preview_df = raw_df.head(MAX_PREVIEW_ROWS)

        meta_text = f"{total_rows:,} rows · {total_cols} cols"
        if total_rows > MAX_PREVIEW_ROWS:
            meta_text += f" (showing first {MAX_PREVIEW_ROWS})"
        if idx == 0:
            first_meta = meta_text

        buttons_html.append(
            f'<button type="button" class="raw-file-btn{active_cls}" '
            f'data-target="raw-pane-{idx}" data-meta="{html_lib.escape(meta_text)}">'
            f'{html_lib.escape(csv_path.name)}</button>'
        )

        table_str = preview_df.to_html(index=False, border=0, justify="left", classes="raw-csv-table")
        panels_html.append(
            f'<div id="raw-pane-{idx}" class="raw-csv-pane" style="display:{display_style};">'
            f'<div class="raw-viewer-box">{table_str}</div>'
            f'</div>'
        )

    display(HTML(f"""
    <div class="raw-toolbar">
      <div class="raw-file-tabs">{''.join(buttons_html)}</div>
      <div id="raw-file-meta" class="raw-meta">{first_meta}</div>
    </div>
    {''.join(panels_html)}
    """))
```

<script>
document.addEventListener("shown.bs.tab", () => {
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize"));
  document.querySelectorAll(".tab-pane.active .js-plotly-plot").forEach(el => {
    if (window.Plotly) Plotly.Plots.resize(el);
  });
});

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  // Toggle Monthly / Totals view in Cost Structure
  const toggleBtn = document.getElementById("btn-toggle-cost");
  const monthlyView = document.getElementById("cost-view-monthly");
  const totalsView = document.getElementById("cost-view-totals");

  if (toggleBtn && monthlyView && totalsView) {
    toggleBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const showingTotals = totalsView.style.display !== "none";
      totalsView.style.display = showingTotals ? "none" : "block";
      monthlyView.style.display = showingTotals ? "block" : "none";
      toggleBtn.textContent = showingTotals ? "Totals" : "Monthly";

      const activePlot = (showingTotals ? monthlyView : totalsView).querySelector(".js-plotly-plot");
      if (activePlot && window.Plotly) {
        Plotly.Plots.resize(activePlot);
      }
    });
  }

  // Column sorting for Accounting Exceptions
  const rank = { CRITICAL: 3, HIGH: 2, MEDIUM: 1, LOW: 0 };
  document.querySelectorAll("table.exceptions th").forEach((th, i) => {
    th.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const table = th.closest("table");
      const tbody = table.querySelector("tbody");
      const asc = th.dataset.sort !== "asc";

      table.querySelectorAll("th").forEach(h => delete h.dataset.sort);
      th.dataset.sort = asc ? "asc" : "desc";

      const val = (tr) => {
        const t = tr.children[i].textContent.trim();
        if (i === 0) return rank[t] ?? -1;
        if (i === 4 || i === 5) return parseFloat(t.replace(/[€,]/g, "")) || 0;
        return t;
      };

      Array.from(tbody.querySelectorAll("tr"))
        .sort((a, b) => {
          const va = val(a), vb = val(b);
          const c = typeof va === "number" ? va - vb : va.localeCompare(vb);
          return asc ? c : -c;
        })
        .forEach(tr => tbody.appendChild(tr));
    });
  });

  // Raw CSV file switcher
  const rawBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".raw-file-btn");
  const rawMeta = document.getElementById("raw-file-meta");
  rawBtns.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      rawBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
      btn.classList.add("active");

      document.querySelectorAll(".raw-csv-pane").forEach(pane => {
        pane.style.display = pane.id === btn.dataset.target ? "block" : "none";
      });

      if (rawMeta && btn.dataset.meta) {
        rawMeta.textContent = btn.dataset.meta;
      }
    });
  });
});
</script>
